items.title: 3.3.3 Dawa sazi (drug designing) mein VSEPR model ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3.3, printed pages 58-59.

blocks.text: Dawaein (drugs) woh kimiyai madde hain jo kisi bimari se bachate, us ki tashkhees (diagnosis) karte ya us ka ilaj karte hain. Woh insani jism se makhsoos nuqton, ya makhsoos amal, jinhen targets ya substrates kehte hain, par apne bioactive molecules, ligands, ke zariye taamul karti hain. Receptor zyada tar ek protein hai jo ligand ko bandhan (binding) ke zariye qabool karta aur jawab deta hai; jism mein targets ki misalein enzymes, proteins, nucleic acids aur cellular pathways jaise receptors hain. Har dawa kisi makhsoos target se mukhtalif darje tak taamul karti hai, jise dawa ya ligand ki makhsoosiyat (specificity) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Chabi aur tala (lock-and-key) ka khaaka. Do chabiyan, A aur B, Receptor likhe block ke oopar jis ka khancha chabi A se milta hai. Do-tarfa teer receptor ki taraf jahan chabi A khanche mein fit hai aur chabi B bahar hai, aur receptor se teer 'Action' ki taraf. Neeche: 'Drug A binds to receptor' aur 'Drug B cannot bind to receptor'.
blocks.caption: Dawa A receptor se jurti hai; dawa B receptor se nahi jur sakti (kitab mein chhape lock-and-key khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Receptor ek tale ki tarah hai aur dawa ek chabi ki tarah. Sirf woh dawa (A) jis ki shakal khanche mein theek baithti hai receptor se jurti hai aur asar (action) paida karti hai; ghalat shakal wali dawa (B) nahi jur sakti. Isi liye dawa banane mein molecule ki shakal aham hai.

Molecule ki shakal ek aham khasoosiyat hai jo tai karti hai ke dawa hayatiyati (biological) target se kaise taamul karti hai: sirf munasib shakal wale ligands target ke active sites mein fit hote hain, jaise makhsoos chabi makhsoos tale mein. VSEPR model mukhtalif hayatiyati systems ki shaklein tai karne mein kamyabi se istemal hota hai, jaise substrate ki pehchan, ligand ki makhsoosiyat ya intikhab, aur antibody ki pehchan. Misal ke taur par aspirin ek analgesic (dard-kush) hai jo dard se aram ke liye bunyadi dawa ke taur par istemal hoti hai. Yeh enzyme COX (cyclooxygenase) se us ke active site par apne acetyl group, -OCCH3, ke zariye bandh kar taamul karti hai. COX ke active site ki shakal aur aspirin par acetyl group ki shakal ek doosre se mutabiq hain, to bandhan kamyab hota hai aur COX ko rokta hai, jo jism mein dard ki ek wajah hai.

blocks.alt: Lipid jhilli (membrane) mein do hare enzyme hisse saath saath, 'Platelet COX-1 dimer' likha. Baen hisse mein 'Ser' wala laal nuqta laal acetyl group (O=C-CH3) rakhta hai, laal bracket ke oopar 'irreversible acetylation' likha. Ek bhara teer aspirin (COOH aur laal O-CO-CH3 group wala benzene ring) se channel mein oopar jata hai, aur dashed teer bahar salicylic acid (COOH aur OH wala benzene ring) ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.21: Aspirin ka COX ke saath taamul (kitab ki Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aspirin channel ke andar ja kar apna acetyl group (laal CH3-C=O) enzyme ke Ser hisse ko de deta hai; is ko acetylation kehte hain aur yeh wapas nahi hota (irreversible). Is ke baad aspirin salicylic acid ban kar bahar nikal jata hai (dashed teer), aur band hua enzyme dard paida karne wale madde nahi bana pata.

blocks.caption: Drug design ke alfaz
rows: Kimiyai madda jo bimari se bachaye, tashkhees kare ya ilaj kare

Bioactive molecule jo target se bandhta hai
Zyada tar protein jo ligand ko bandhan se qabool karta aur jawab deta hai
Dawa kisi ek khas target se kitni mazbooti se taamul karti hai

blocks.prompt: Aspirin ki misal se wazahat karein ke dawa banane wale chemist ke liye molecule ki shakal ka andaza kyun aham hai.
blocks.explanation: Dawa sirf tab kaam karti hai jab us ki shakal apne target ke active site mein fit ho, jaise chabi tale mein. Aspirin ke acetyl group ki shakal enzyme COX ke active site se mutabiq hai, to woh wahan bandhti hai aur dard paida karne wale enzyme ko rokti hai. Jo chemist VSEPR se shaklein aur bond zawiye bata sakta hai woh molecule banane se pehle andaza laga sakta hai ke woh apne target mein fit hoga ya nahi.

items: Dawaein ligands ke zariye targets par asar karti hain; receptor ligand ko bandhta hai; specificity target se taamul ka darja hai.
Shakal fit tai karti hai, jaise chabi tale mein; VSEPR shaklein batata hai. Aspirin ka acetyl group enzyme COX ke active site mein fit ho kar use rokta hai, dard se aram deta hai.
